Irene —

Thanks for the clear plan. For NovaHealth we do require an escrowed copy for residency proof due to their contractual clause on data residency for telemetry-derived artifacts. A signed attest and a Drive link are acceptable for most items, but telemetry extracts must be escrowed (we accept encrypted tar.gz with SHA256 checksums). Our escrow provider is VaultSafe — contact: Marcus Li <marcus.li@vaultsafe.com>.

File naming: <vendor>_<account>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>. Example: redwood_nova_health_telemetry_20260820.tar.gz. Please include a short KMS provenance note (key id and region) in a separate .md file inside the archive.

I can take the 20-min call on Thu 8/20 at 10:15am PT. Please send an invite.

Best,
Laura
Laura Perez
Head of Vendor Legal, NovaLegal (on behalf of NovaHealth)
